summary: Ochoco NF tower site in Crook County, OR: a cabin moved there in 1929, a 40-foot tower built in 1930, staffed until 1942. Removed; no removal date or present condition found.

facts.design: 40-foot wood pole tower of round timber, with a 7 by 7 foot cab and a frame house on top
facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the tower has been removed; no removal date or present condition is given in the sources

staffing.status: last staffed 1942 per Forest Lookouts item

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Ochoco National Forest

events.note: July 1929 item: a fireman's cabin to be moved from Pine Creek ranger station to the top of the butte; September 1929 item: it was moved
George J. Roba named as lookout-fireman in 1929 items
40-foot wood tower by Ira Swift and George Roba; September 1930 item says under construction, November 1930 item says completed
Al Frey stationed there during the summer; December 1931 item says he completed the tower that season
Robert Brink, lookout, left his station July 13, 1942 to report to a Marine training base
Registered June 13, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1929 for the 40-foot tower. The Forest Lookouts sources show that the cabin was moved to the butte in 1929 and that the 40-foot tower was built in 1930: a September 1930 item reports it under construction and a November 1930 item reports it completed. A December 1931 item says the finishing work was done that season. Sources do not reconcile these; the story reports both dates.

notes_for_editor: No removal date or reason found in any source. Two web searches turned up no removal record and no link between this site and 'Roba Swift' other than the Roba name in the Forest Lookouts items. If the tower record holds a built year of 1929, a human may want to change it to 1930 (the tower) with a note that the cabin came in 1929; the brief did not show a built field, so no correction is proposed here. Access and present condition: no source read. The 40-foot figure gives height_m 12.2 (about 40 ft). Elevation 6,266 ft matches the record.
